name: Zelek
overview: Zelek was a male Ammonite who was notably counted among "the thirty," an elite group of David's mighty men. He is identified specifically as the thirty-third member of this distinguished band, highlighting his role as a warrior under King David. Beyond his tribal affiliation and military status, no additional personal details are recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Zelek means "cry aloud," a proper name recorded in 2 Samuel 23:37. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it may reflect a characteristic or role associated with him.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture infers that Zelek was a descendant of Ben-ammi, linking him to the Ammonite lineage. No other family relationships are documented beyond this association.
scriptureSignificance: Zelek's inclusion among David's "thirty" signifies his importance as one of the king's trusted and valiant warriors, despite being an Ammonite by tribe. This highlights the diverse composition of David's forces and demonstrates God's providence in raising up men from various backgrounds to serve His purposes. His mention affirms the historical reality of David's mighty men and their crucial role in establishing Israel's monarchy.
